sheets.title: An /invoke/mfa link on a device with no vault — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Before, the link met the front door with the code still in the address. After, the hand-off opens by itself — no unlock, no vault — and the query left the address before the first paint.
sheets.before: front door (.unlock 1); first render …/invoke/mfa?user_code=abcd-1234; focus on the sign-in field
sheets.after: first render …/invoke/mfa (query gone); .unlock 0, .note 0; h1 Approve with OpenSesame, Code ABCD-1234; .go 44×44 → opensesame://invoke/mfa?user_code=ABCD-1234, focused (focus-visible); fallback key 44×44 → /OpenSesame/device?user_code=ABCD-1234

sheets.title: Continue in this browser: /device with the code — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Continue in this browser opens /device, which takes the code from its own address into memory as it does for any device link; after Connect the approval form holds it.
sheets.before: no fallback to follow: front door, focus on the sign-in field
sheets.after: address …/OpenSesame/device (code gone); h1 Approve a device; User code field ABCD-1234 after Connect (stand-in provisional principal); Approve device key 44×44

sheets.title: An /invoke/oid4vp link: the hand-off only — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: A wallet request is handed to the openid4vp scheme and nothing else: no fallback, and the request URI is never fetched.
sheets.before: front door (.unlock 1); ?request_uri= still in the address
sheets.after: address …/invoke/oid4vp; h1 Present a credential with OpenSesame, From verifier.evidence.example; one link → openid4vp://?request_uri=…; 0 requests to verifier.evidence.example; .go focused

sheets.title: An unknown kind, refused — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: A kind the spec does not list is refused in ceremony-kit's words, on a mark (and in the tray); nothing to press.
sheets.before: front door (.unlock 1); query still in the address; 0 marks
sheets.after: address …/invoke/totp; h1 Authenticator request, OpenSesame did not open (err: Unknown authenticator request.); 0 links; refusal panel 358×41 focused

sheets.title: A request id and a user code in one link, refused — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: A request id and a user code in one link: ceremony-kit's parser takes exactly one handle, so the link is refused rather than guessed at.
sheets.before: front door (.unlock 1); both handles still in the address
sheets.after: address …/invoke/mfa; OpenSesame did not open (err: This link must contain exactly one request handle.); 0 links, .note 0
